**Demographic Factors:**
• Female gender (especially post-menopausal)
• Advanced age (over 50)
• Caucasian or Asian ethnicity
• Family history of osteoporosis

• Low estrogen levels/menopause
• Eating disorders (anorexia, bulimia)  
• Chronic kidney disease
• Inflammatory bowel disease
• Rheumatoid arthritis
• Hyperthyroidism/hyperparathyroidism

**Lifestyle Factors:**
• Low body weight/small frame
• Smoking
• Excessive alcohol consumption
• Lack of weight-bearing exercise
• Low calcium and vitamin D intake

**Medications:**
• Long-term corticosteroid use
• Certain anticonvulsants (phenytoin, carbamazepine)

Bacterial Infections:

Cannot be treated with antibiotics

Often systemic (e.g., cold, flu, COVID-19)

Usually resolve on their own in 7-10 days

Treatment focuses on symptom relief
